Release 1.4.0 with maintained feedback and regression verification

Release 1.4.0 with accepted Phase 23 detector, offline regression and maintenance changes.

Retain the accepted Phase 22 scope and historical failures, unsupported Proxmox, and current FAF compatibility remaining unestablished. Preserve deferred pilots, paid benchmarks and Phase 24/15 gates.
